purpose: Block-stuffing defence (audit X-14/X-15, Chad 2026-11-25: per-sender limits plus time-based windows). Applied to every validator and the RPC node by install-besu.py and to the local rehearsal by Tools/Genesis/localnet.py. Flags checked against besu 26.8.1 --help.

prioritySenders.note: Governance and system senders are kept and selected first, so a stuffed pool cannot exclude a vote, a cancel or a guardian pause. Roots and voters come from the genesis inputs; add the guardian, timelock executors, Paladin settlement and FEeD relayers when they exist.
